Tenancy: Ask agent Let type: Long term Furnish type: Furnished or unfurnished, landlord is flexible Council Tax: Ask agent PROPERTY TYPE Apartment BEDROOMS 3 BATHROOMS 2 SIZE 1,100 sq ft 102 sq m 1 +5 Key features 4 Weeks Rent Free - Move In & SaveZero Deposit Option AvailableState-of-the-Art On-Site Gym24/7 Concierge & Dedicated On-Site Maintenance TeamExclusive Resident Events & Community ProgrammePrivate Car Parking Available5 Rooftop Terraces & Landscaped CourtyardsPersonalise Your Home - Option to Paint Your ApartmentResident Lounges & Co-Working Spaces6 Mins to White City | 21 Mins to Liverpool Street | 26 Mins to Oxford Circus Description Lifestyle-led. 4 WEEKS RENT FREE | ZERO DEPOSIT OPTION | Welcome to luxury living in North Kensington. Exclusive apartments finished to an exceptional standard, with 24-hour concierge, a residents' gym equipped with Technogym, spectacular roof terraces, and car parking from £70pcm - everything you need, right on your doorstep! Enjoy the reassurance of a 24/7 concierge, on-site maintenance, and a dedicated management team on hand whenever you need support. Outside your front door, you’ll find an exceptional selection of lifestyle amenities: work up a sweat in the on-site gym, unwind across five beautifully designed rooftop terraces and courtyards, and get to know your neighbours through exclusive resident events. If you work from home, the resident lounges and co-working spaces offer a stylish, comfortable setting to stay productive without leaving the building. On-site parking is available (subject to availability), completing the convenience of living at Mitre Yard.
